marketing_description: The DeWALT DCK225D2 Brushless Compact Drill/Driver and Impact Driver Combo Kit offers a compact design and powerful performance, with up to 16% more power for drilling applications and 1,700 in-lbs of torque. This cordless combo kit includes a charger and features onboard LEDs to illuminate dim workspaces. It is backed by a 3 year limited warranty, 1 year free service, and 90 days satisfaction guaranteed.
